$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Group id, e.g. "endings". Facts are keyed by `key`, not by this.

notes.description: What these facts cover and where they come from (canon section), for review.

key.description: Fact key, or an `entity:*.<fact>` template for a fact every entity can hold.

description.description: What the fact records, when it changes and what reads it (designers, owner review).

owner.description: System that writes the fact, e.g. "signals", "quest", "interaction".

renamedFrom.description: Keys this fact was saved under before (any older spelling; for a template, older templates). A save holding one loads into this key with its value (mw-e27.4); never remove an entry once a build shipped it.

persistence.description: How long a written value lasts; `permanent` keeps it in saves forever.

default.description: Value read before the fact is first written.
